content:
Hi everyone!

The readme of verso-web-components describes itself as "components from the Lean website designed build related sites". What does "related sites" mean? For example, is a website for a project using Lean fits in this category?

I am asking this question because I wanted to use verso-web-components for the website of my project, but noticed that the Lean logo in the navbar is hardcoded into the theme, which seems to imply that verso-web-components is not targeted to my usage (otherwise, it would be useful to make the logo a parameter of the theme!)

verso-web-components is indeed targeted towards internal use in websites directly affiliated with Lean — I'd recommend forking the repository if you want to specialize it or create a less specialized version for yourself and others to use
